messages:
Maya: Quick UX thread 1: thinking about adding schema badges and an explicit 'Invoke' CTA in the playground run history. Goal: faster scan + fewer accidental re-runs. Need design + a11y input.
Samir: Mock uploaded: https://figma.com/s/schema-badges-invoker. Idea: each history row shows small badges for param count, schema-validity (check/warn), and duration. Clicking a badge reveals a compact schema preview.
Eli: A11y: badges must be keyboard reachable and have descriptive aria-labels (e.g., "3 params, click to preview"). Use role=button on badges and aria-expanded when previewing. Keep tab order predictable: row action > badges > primary CTA.
Nora: Copy nit: primary action on row should be "Invoke" (not Run or Re-run). For replays, label secondary CTA "Invoke (with same inputs)" or "Invoke again". Avoid ambiguous icons without labels.
Zoe: Interaction note: avoid inline expansion pushing other rows out of view. Propose the badge opens a small popover anchored to the badge with a monospaced snippet and "Open full schema" link. Popover dismiss on Escape and click outside.
Maya: Accessibility checklist: visible 4px focus ring on badges and CTAs, popover must have role=dialog and aria-modal=false (non-blocking), focus returns to originating badge on close. Respect reduced-motion for popover animations.
Eli: Live streaming case: popover should show a collapsed live preview updating first key/value and announce updates with aria-live=polite. If streaming tokens are lengthy, show a "Stream details" link that opens a modal.
Samir: Engineering: backend will add badge metadata to /history results: param_count, schema_status (ok/warn/error), exec_ms. Client: lazy-load full schema only when user opens popover or modal. We'll implement an LRU cache for expanded schemas.
Nora: For function defs: render params as inline chips with type and optional description tooltip. Add a "Edit example" quick action that inserts example payload into the playground prompt area.
Maya: Quick poll: reply BADGE (popover) or INLINE (expand row). I'll collect votes and pick default for next sprint. Also tagging Eli to add keyboard flows to the prototype and Samir to add the API fields to the ticket.
deploy-bot: feature-flag update: feature-flag:history_schema_badges -> enabled for 10% at 2025-06-12T08:15:00Z.
Eli: BADGE
Zoe: BADGE
Samir: BADGE
Nora: INLINE (prefer inline for debugging)
Maya: Thanks 1! Outcome: default to BADGE with popover + "Open full schema" modal for deep inspect. Eli, please prototype badge keyboard navigation and aria-live streaming text. Samir, file the backend PR for badge metadata. I'll update the copy doc to standardize on "Invoke" and "Invoke again" for CTAs.
